Team task: Four assistants share the folder /shared to finish the payments-platform config migration from format v1 to v2. Each assistant owns one service's config file.

Your own files are in /home/jun/ and only you can see them. The team folder /shared/ is used by all four assistants (jun, dana, faye, ivo). There is no chat or messaging: files in /shared are the only way to share anything with the others.

| db_host       | database.host       |
| timeout_ms    | timeouts.request_ms |
